findings.current: Jeong Hogun led Prince Shangshan and me along behind one of the middle-aged twins whose names I didn’t know, and sent us a brief Sound Transmission.
findings.defect: Jeong leads them to the twins, not along behind one twin.
findings.rationale: 쌍둥이 중년인에게 나와 상산왕을 인도하며 makes the twins the people to whom Jeong brings the pair.
findings.replacement: Jeong Hogun led Prince Shangshan and me over to the middle-aged twins, whose names I didn’t know, and sent us a brief Sound Transmission.
findings.source: 정호군은 이름 모를 쌍둥이 중년인에게 나와 상산왕을 인도하며 짧은 전음을 남겼다.

findings.current: What the hell was he trying to scare us for?
findings.defect: Changes the accusation from insulting or messing with someone to trying to frighten them, while softening the insult.
findings.rationale: 누굴 놀리나 questions whom Jeong thinks he is fooling; 시벌놈이 is a direct, strong insult.
findings.replacement: Who the fuck did that bastard think he was kidding?

findings.current: I clenched my teeth to hold back a sigh.
findings.defect: Replaces biting his lip with clenching his teeth.
findings.rationale: 입술을 질끈 깨물었다 explicitly describes biting his lip.
findings.replacement: I bit my lip hard to hold back a sigh.
findings.source: 나는 흘러나오려는 한숨을 삼키기 위해 입술을 질끈 깨물었다.

findings.current: The middle-aged man gazed at Prince Shangshan, his face set, and at me, standing at an angle to shield him. Only when the echoes had faded did he speak.
findings.defect: The placement of “his face set” makes it appear to describe the middle-aged man rather than Prince Shangshan.
findings.rationale: 굳은 얼굴을 한 modifies 상산왕; the man's expression is not specified there.
findings.replacement: The middle-aged man gazed at the tense-faced Prince Shangshan and at me, standing slightly in front of him to shield him. Only when the echoes had faded did he speak.
findings.source: 굳은 얼굴을 한 상산왕과 비스듬히 그 앞을 가로막은 나를 물끄러미 바라보던 중년인이 입을 연 것은 메아리가 사라진 그때였다.

findings.current: I forgot to mention that the accounts I heard were considerably more flattering than the truth.
findings.defect: Reverses who softened the account: the speaker toned down his own description of Jin, not the reports he heard.
findings.rationale: The speaker is qualifying his immediately preceding description against the harsher things reported to him.
findings.replacement: I forgot to mention that ‘making people laugh’ was a considerably toned-down version of what I’d heard.
findings.source: 전해 들은 여러 말에서 상당히 순화했다는 표현을 깜빡했군.

findings.current: He opened a golden door decorated with jewels without the slightest hesitation, then spoke.
findings.defect: Makes the door itself golden and omits its silver decoration.
findings.rationale: 금은보화로 장식된 describes a door decorated with gold, silver, and treasures, not necessarily one made of gold.
findings.replacement: He threw open the door before them, decorated with gold, silver, and jewels, without the slightest hesitation, then spoke.
findings.source: 어느덧 앞을 가로막은, 금은보화로 장식된 문을 망설임 없이 열어젖힌 그가 입을 열었다.

summary: Several action, subject, and register changes need correction; the remaining terminology warnings do not establish defects.
